column1: # PAGE-FIDELITY.tsv — appended by project-bin/page-fidelity.js on every run.
# The first NON-STUB row for a page is its first-build score of record (target:
# >=80%); later rows for the same page show the rework curve. Rows with source
# `stub` are forward-reference targets (scored with --stub) and are exempt from
# the target. `module` is the page's module as declared in its CREATE PAGE
# statement — this is what the fidelity obligation (bin/lib/obligations.tsv)
# greps for; a blank module leaves that module's obligation PENDING forever, so
# never blank it by hand. Do not edit rows by hand.
